Event: Harby summit in Pellport. Host: Alba Garcroft. Budget: 33,250. Capacity: 165. Requirements: 10 breakout rooms.

Staff Changes: Leon out (Cora covers); Rafe out (Vik covers); Pia out (Ines covers); Bram out (Nils covers); Wren out (Cora covers).

Desk Swaps: Finn/Hugo, Leon/Rafe, Opal/Bram, Wren/Greta, Greta/Ines, Mira/Greta, Teo/Dell, Ines/Hugo, Jonah/Leon, Ines/Una.

Room Preferences: Cora, Finn, Ada, Vik, Rafe keep Garden Studio/Loading Bay clear. Wren wants Harbour room. Greta prefers Harbour room. Bram, Nils want Garden Studio. Opal, Dell, Hugo want Loading Bay/Library annex. Suri wants North office. Leon wants East Wing.

Room Status: North office (repainting, noisy afternoon, coffee OK, umbrella there). Library annex (repainting, noisy evening, coffee OK, umbrella there, slow lift). Print room (cold, slow lift, repainting, umbrella there). Garden studio (slow lift, umbrella there). Loading bay (coffee OK, Kira/Leon/Greta note cold/evening issues, repainting, umbrella there, slow lift). Harbour room (repainting, noisy evening, slow lift). East Wing (cold afternoon, slow lift, coffee OK, umbrella there).

Tasks: Send notes to Rafe, Wren, Cora, Greta, Suri, Nils, Hugo, Pia. Check with Cora (morning), Finn, Jonah (evening). Draft note to Bram. Send notes to Dell. Stand-ups: Morning to Print room, Afternoon to Harbour room, Evening to North office.

People: Involving: Ines, Finn, Mira, Ada, Greta, Leon, Dell. Una asked about availability. Opal asked about Loading Bay evening. Teo asked about Print room afternoon. Lift near Garden Studio is slow today. Lift near North Office is slow today.

Updates: Mira thinks Print room is too cold in afternoon. Coffee machine in Library annex is working. Opal asked if East Wing is free in afternoon.
